recommendations.action: Add an independent high-pressure trip on reactor R-1 that closes the steam supply valve to R-1, with pressure sensor independent of cooling water system UT-K-CW.
recommendations.reason: Same root cause as L1; this single engineered layer addresses both line scenarios by stopping steam heating on R-1 when pressure exceeds setpoint, independent of condenser E-1 cooling water loss.

recommendations.action: Install an independent high-level trip on reactor R-1 that closes the monomer feed block valve referenced in BATCH-SHEET-K-7-2 and BATCH-SHEET-K-7-5, with level sensor independent of operator actions.
recommendations.reason: Addresses operator error causing excess monomer flow by adding an engineered layer that automatically stops feed on high level, removing reliance on batch sheet compliance.

recommendations.action: Install a fire detection system at LOC-K-MFG that triggers an independent trip to close steam supply to R-1 and open the emergency vent valve on R-1, independent of cooling water status.
recommendations.reason: Addresses the combined fire and cooling water loss by providing a dedicated fire-induced trip that isolates heat input and depressurizes R-1, independent of the failed utility UT-K-CW.

recommendations.action: Revise BATCH-SHEET-K-7-2 to require a documented monomer feed valve position verification with dual operator sign-off before reactor start-up.
recommendations.reason: Closes the gap by eliminating the root cause (valve left wrong) through procedural control, avoiding reliance on PSV-1 which does not protect level drop.

recommendations.reason: Addresses the operator error cause directly; no existing protection layers, so procedural interlock removes the hazard.

recommendations.action: Install fire-rated insulation and a fire detection trip on the condensate line (LOC-K-MFG) that automatically isolates the line on fire detection.
